Approved charcoal plates and ember seams retained. Unequal row layout cropped explicitly; late keys appear somewhat larger, owner review for anatomical scale in motion.

Twelve poses in 4/2/3/3 layout. Top ready duplicates excluded; both hit clips select a clear lifted-neck recoil and braced recovery from later stronger keys. Rear dorsal plates retained. Some keys resemble a bark/lunge, owner review for hit readability. Authored component centres isolate the irregular layout without cutting overlapping pose bounding boxes; no body reconstruction.

Corrected rear motion: four subtle idle keys, five selected bound keys showing forepaw reach/contact and airborne hind extension, five attack keys from head-lowering to jaw-open lunge and rear recovery. Near-duplicate run key 7 and extra mouth-flame key 14 excluded. Gait is a candidate for owner timing review, not a six-key alternating-stride claim.

Roomier 2x3 correction separates all six rear hounds. Four low forepaw-planted resistance keys selected; standing entry keys omitted. Rear charcoal back and ember seams retained. Bounding boxes overlap across row boundaries but disjoint opaque components are isolated without body edits. Owner review for hunched-loop motion.

Nine poses supplied instead of six. Front-right chest and muzzle anatomy retained; selected progressive lowering then side-lying endpoint. Pink ground shadows key out locally; purple matte spill remains a style-review limitation.

Seven poses in a 3/2/2 layout. Front-right face and turquoise throat remain visible while chest and jaw descend. Final closed-eye amphibian lies flat on its belly with relaxed splayed limbs; no hovering or crouched torso. Approved moss-green volume and cyan throat retained. Late poses somewhat broader; owner motion review remains open.

Corrected front motion: four idle breaths; five selected hop keys progress crouch, push, airborne travel, foreleg landing and settle; rear-facing key 4 excluded. Attack now opens mouth without a detached projectile and returns to ready; throat charge paint remains attached. Oblique view narrows toward side during hop; owner gait and facing readability review remains open.

More rounded, smoother face and larger eyes than original approved source are explicit owner-review identity/style limitations; palette and broad amphibian anatomy match. Nine rear/dorsal poses. Front-turn key 7 excluded. Quick clip selects a sharp folded-wing recoil and return; heavy sweeps four wings and bends thorax then recovers. Pale generated sweep wisps remain around some keys as localized motion paint, not labels. No claim that every requested pose or grid was followed; owner review for recoil versus ordinary wingbeat.

Sixteen poses instead of twelve. Rear attack uses six wing gather/buffet/recovery paintings; resistance selects six rear wing-shield and curled-body effort poses from later rows. Front-turn keys 13/14 excluded. Generated pale sweep wisps remain localized; the engine still owns effects and abilities. Owner review for guard-loop continuity.

Four usable generated front-right keys: source 2 hovers front-on, 3 descends, 4 folds wings low, 5 rests thorax and folded wings against ground. First two rear-facing keys excluded. Nine front moth poses. Short clip flares and counter-sweeps wings then returns to folded hover. Heavy clip turns thorax, folds wings unevenly and catches balance before recovering. Four-wing silhouette, silver veins and midnight pigment retained; eyes are brighter violet than original and route to owner for identity review. No ground poses used in hits.

Front motion salvage: two idle flutter keys, five wingbeat flight keys, and an authored attack sequence returning to the exact ready key. Keys with shortened/missing antennae and rear-facing burst excluded. Four distinct attack paintings supply five frame references. Localized lilac wing wisps remain; antenna/eye variation and buffet readability route to owner.

Nine source poses rather than six. Selected four front-right planted wing-fold resistance variations. Pale veins, dark wing planes and lilac wisps retained; subtle effort and side-biased camera require owner review. No run or attack claimed.
